verdict.rationale: First-party docs show event-driven triggers. Developers can subscribe to events like `create_item` and `change_column_value` and run workflows the moment data changes. Agents fire when they are messaged, assigned an item, or mentioned. Users can also 'set the rules' for agents, use integrations to trigger automations, and run scheduled automations. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of a rule/automation builder (trigger-condition-action recipes, conditional logic), and independent or hands-on corroboration that event-triggered rules work as described.
